;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Moro conflict]]
**[[Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters]] rebels storm a school in [[Pigcawayan]], [[North Cotabato]], [[Philippines]],  and take civilians hostage. [http://www.smh.com.au/world/islamic-militants-storm-school-in-the-philippines-20170621-gwve9k.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*[[Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017)|Iraqi Civil War]]
**[[Battle of Mosul (2016–2017)|Battle of Mosul]]
***[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants reportedly blow up the [[Great Mosque of al-Nuri (Mosul)|Great Mosque of al-Nuri]] in [[Mosul]], where [[Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi]] famously proclaimed the creation of a caliphate in 2014. ISIL blames a U.S. airstrike. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-40361857 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*[[International Yoga Day]]
**More than 50,000 people practice [[yoga]] in [[Lucknow]], [[India]], to celebrate [[International Yoga Day]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170621081330/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/intl-yoga-day-marked-millions-india-began-48174787 (ABC News)]
*[[International Dublin Literary Award]]
**Author [[José Eduardo Agualusa]] wins the [[International Dublin Literary Award]] for his novel ''[[A General Theory of Oblivion]]''. ([https://www.irishtimes.com/culture/books/josé-eduardo-agualusa-wins-100-000-international-dublin-literary-award-1.3127773?mode=amp ''The Irish Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
** The United Kingdom experiences its first early summer heat wave in over 20 years, and the highest recorded June temperatures in over 40 years with a reading of 34.5C (94F) recorded at [[Heathrow Airport]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-40353118 (BBC)]
*[[2017 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**A ten-year-old boy dies from injuries sustained during [[Tropical Storm Cindy (2017)|Tropical Storm Cindy]] in [[Fort Morgan, Alabama]]. [http://wreg.com/2017/06/21/tropical-storm-cindy-blamed-in-10-year-olds-death/ (WREG)]

;Law and crime
*[[Bishop International Airport attack]]
**A police officer is stabbed in the neck at [[Bishop International Airport]] in [[Flint, Michigan]]. The FBI is investigating the incident as terrorism. The suspect was arrested on scene and charged with a federal count of violence at an international airport. The victim survived. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/06/21/flint-bishop-airport-police-officer-stabbed-airport-evacuated-and-suspect-in-custody.html (Fox News)]
*[[2017 Beckton acid attack]]
**Two people are injured in an [[acid attack]] in [[Beckton]], [[east London]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-40398089 (BBC News)]
*[[Child marriage#Asia and Oceania|Child marriage in Australia]]
**An Imam in [[Australia]] who married a 14 year old to a 34 year old will not face jail time despite conviction. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/imam-marries-14-year-old-10661681 (''Daily Mirror'') ]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Saudi Arabia]]
**In a royal decree, [[King of Saudi Arabia|King]] [[Salman of Saudi Arabia]] appoints his son [[Mohammad bin Salman Al Saud]] as [[Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia|Crown Prince]], stripping his nephew [[Muhammad bin Nayef]] of the title. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/21/saudi-king-upends-tradition-by-naming-son-as-first-in-line-to-throne (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Politics of Romania]]
**After a short term political crisis, started when the governing [[Social Democratic Party (Romania)|PSD]] retracted its support, the [[Parliament of Romania]] passes a [[no confidence motion]] against the government led by former PSD [[Prime Minister of Romania|Prime Minister]] [[Sorin Grindeanu]]. [http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_ROMANIA_POLITICS?SITE=AP&SECTION=HOME&TEMPLATE=DEFAULT (AP)]
*[[Second Philippe Government]]
**[[François Bayrou]] resigns as [[France]]'s [[Ministry of Justice (France)|Minister of Justice]] amid an ongoing investigation into the centrist [[Democratic Movement (France)|Democratic Movement]] (MoDem)'s alleged fraudulent employment of parliamentary assistants. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40351918 (BBC)] 

;Science and technology
*[[Cosmic Vision]]
**The [[European Space Agency]] (ESA) approves the [[PLATO (spacecraft)|PLATO]] [[space observatory]] which will seek out [[Earth]]-like [[exoplanet]]s. [http://news.sky.com/story/esas-plato-deep-space-observatory-to-join-hunt-for-new-planets-10922376 (Sky News)]
